meta.title: Warehouse full workflow — video demo dummy data
meta.purpose: Shareable end-to-end warehouse story: sticker → customer gives driver → gatekeeper scan → GRN/GDO → invoices.

videoStoryboard.title: Customer booking / warehouse job
videoStoryboard.sayOnCamera: Customer Al Maha Trading books carton storage at Jebel Ali warehouse.

videoStoryboard.title: Sticker / barcode label
videoStoryboard.sayOnCamera: We print the warehouse sticker — CODE128 barcode the driver must carry.

videoStoryboard.title: What customer gives the driver
videoStoryboard.route: Show printed sticker + handoff card (print from fixture)
videoStoryboard.sayOnCamera: Customer hands the driver: printed sticker, job reference, and gate instructions.
handOffPack: Driver name + plate on gate card
Warehouse gate: JAFZA Gate 3 — inbound dock B

videoStoryboard.title: Gatekeeper check-in
videoStoryboard.sayOnCamera: Gatekeeper scans the sticker, confirms job details, and records gate location.
actions: Optional Scan with location + notes (driver + plate)

videoStoryboard.title: Inbound GRN (gate-in stock)
videoStoryboard.sayOnCamera: We book stock in with GRN linked to the same job, then Post for gate-in.

videoStoryboard.title: Storage charges → invoice
videoStoryboard.sayOnCamera: After free days, storage is calculated and the customer invoice is raised.

videoStoryboard.title: Customer sees invoice
videoStoryboard.sayOnCamera: Customer opens the portal and reviews the warehouse storage invoice.

videoStoryboard.title: Outbound GDO (driver collects)
videoStoryboard.sayOnCamera: When the customer collects, we gate-out with GDO and hand the exit pass.

manualUiChecklist: Create or open WAREHOUSE job with Al Maha / demo commodity (or run seed).
Job Overview: download/print barcode sticker PDF — film the sticker clearly.
Print or show driverHandoffCard lines next to sticker (customer → driver).
Open /jobs/barcode-scan — paste KF-WH-DEMO-001 (or real job barcode) — show job details.
Scan with location JAFZA Gate 3 and driver notes.
Create GRN linked to job + warehouse + item → Post.
Calculate storage on /warehouse/storage → raise invoice → open /invoices/:id.
Create GDO → Post for exit handoff.
